'''Star Tours Flight 1203''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]] and [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The flight was cancelled on the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], when it was originally set to arrive at the spaceport's Gate 2B at 1305 hours and depart again at 1400.
